title: Epic: filesystem directory keystore backend
description: Add a new opt-in backend (FSDIR=1) that loads .p11k keystore files from a configured filesystem directory instead of USB removable media. Each .p11k file in the directory maps to one PKCS#11 slot. Supports containers, embedded Linux, CI/CD, and any deployment where USB removable media is unavailable or undesirable. The wp11_keystore.c AES-GCM format is already implemented; this epic wires it up to a directory source with optional inotify watching instead of USB hotplug detection.
